d: Provide personalized beauty consultations across skincare, makeup, haircare, and fragrance categories.
Educate customers on product benefits, usage techniques, and application methods to enhance product confidence.
Build strong customer relationships to drive loyalty, retention, and repeat visits.
Deliver a luxury-level service experience aligned with brand standards.
Achieve individual and store KPIs including sales targets, conversion rate, UPT (Units per Transaction), and ATV (Average Transaction Value).
Stay updated on new launches, hero SKUs, ingredients, shade ranges, and category trends.
Support in-store promotions, sampling programs, and campaign storytelling.
Proactively cross-sell and recommend complementary products to enhance the customer experience.
Maintain high standards of product displays, tester hygiene, shelves, and gondolas in line with visual merchandising guidelines.
Ensure products are properly stocked, priced, tagged, and presented.
Support visual merchandising updates, layout refreshes, and seasonal changes.
Follow SOPs related to grooming, hygiene, and daily store checklists.
Assist in stock replenishment, expiry checks (FIFO/FEFO), and shrinkage control.
Support inventory activities including stock counts, delivery checks, and stock movement coordination.
Share feedback on customer preferences, product performance, and category insights.
Assist in onboarding and guiding new team members on product knowledge and service standards.
q: 1–3 years of experience in beauty, cosmetics, skincare, or premium retail.
Strong product knowledge across beauty categories with a passion for consultation and customer service.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable products.
High standards of grooming and presentation aligned with luxury retail environments.
Sales-driven mindset with the ability to achieve KPIs in a fast-paced setting.
Knowledge of makeup application, skincare routines, or fragrance layering is an advantage.

The Registered Nurse is responsible for providing safe, compassionate, and evidence based nursing care to patients experiencing mental health conditions. The role involves supporting patients across assessment, treatment, recovery, and ongoing management, while working closely with psychiatrists, psychologists, and the wider multidisciplinary team to deliver high quality mental health services.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing from an accredited institution.
DOH license holder or eligibility letter.
Minimum 3 years of clinical experience in a mental health or psychiatric care setting.
r: Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments, including risk assessments, and contribute to individualized care plans.
Deliver therapeutic nursing interventions and monitor patients’ mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
Administer and monitor medications in accordance with clinical guidelines and physician instructions.
Support patients and families through education, counselling, and psychoeducation to promote recovery and adherence to treatment.
Accurately document patient care, progress notes, and incidents in line with regulatory and organizational standards.
Collaborate with the multidisciplinary team to ensure coordinated, patient-centred care.

Promotes a safe therapeutic environment through adherence to patient safety, safeguarding, infection prevention, clinical governance, and mental health care standards, while actively participating in audits and quality improvement initiatives.
